import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def cloud(folder):
    folder=Path(folder)
    meta=json.loads((folder/'meta.json').read_text())
    clouds=[]
    for cam,c in meta['cameras'].items():
        im=np.asarray(Image.open(folder/(cam+'.png'))).astype(float)
        depth=np.load(folder/('depth_'+cam+'.npy')).astype(float)
        mask=(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,0]*1.4+10)&(im[:,:,1]>im[:,:,2]*1.4+10)
        v,u=np.nonzero(mask)
        K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
        z=depth[v,u]
        p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*z,-(v-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*z,-z]).T
        p=p@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]
        clouds.append(p)
        print(cam, len(p), 'xyz min/max', p.min(axis=0) if len(p) else None, p.max(axis=0) if len(p) else None)
    return np.concatenate(clouds)

def fit_floor_box(p):
    half=np.array([.02,.02,.03])
    def fun(x):
        R=Rotation.from_euler('z',x[2]).as_matrix()
        local=(p-np.r_[x[:2],.03])@R
        d=np.abs(local)-half
        # signed box surface distance
        outside=np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(d,0),axis=1)
        inside=np.minimum(np.max(d,axis=1),0)
        return outside+inside
    fits=[]
    for yaw in np.linspace(-np.pi/4,np.pi/4,9):
        f=least_squares(fun,[*np.median(p[:,:2],axis=0),yaw],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=.001)
        fits.append(f)
    f=min(fits,key=lambda f:f.cost)
    print('FLOOR_BOX',f.x,'rms',np.sqrt(np.mean(fun(f.x)**2)))
    return np.r_[f.x[:2],.03],Rotation.from_euler('z',f.x[2]).as_matrix()
if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    p=cloud(sys.argv[1]); fit_floor_box(p)

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
xyz=np.array([[0,0,.333],[0,0,0],[0,-.316,0],[.0825,0,0],[-.0825,.384,0],[0,0,0],[.088,0,0]])
rx=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
limits=np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-.0698],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-.0175,3.7525],[-2.8973,2.8973]])

def tf(p=(0,0,0),R=np.eye(3)):
    T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=R; T[:3,3]=p; return T

def fk(q,tip=.1034,all_links=False):
    T=np.eye(4); links=[]
    for p,a,theta in zip(xyz,rx,q):
        T=T@tf(p,Rotation.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix())@tf(R=Rotation.from_euler('z',theta).as_matrix())
        links.append(T.copy())
    T=T@tf([0,0,.107],Rotation.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix())
    links.append(T.copy())
    T=T@tf([0,0,tip]); links.append(T.copy())
    return links if all_links else T

def ik(p,R,q0,reg=.002):
    q0=np.array(q0)
    def residual(q):
        T=fk(q)
        return np.r_[5*(T[:3,3]-p),Rotation.from_matrix(T[:3,:3]@R.T).as_rotvec(),reg*(q-q0)]
    fit=least_squares(residual,np.clip(q0,limits[:,0]+1e-7,limits[:,1]-1e-7),bounds=(limits[:,0],limits[:,1]),max_nfev=300,ftol=1e-11,gtol=1e-11,xtol=1e-11)
    T=fk(fit.x)
    print('IK',fit.x,'position error',np.linalg.norm(T[:3,3]-p),'rotation error',np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(T[:3,:3]@R.T).as_rotvec()))
    return fit.x

if __name__=='__main__':

    for cam,c in meta['cameras'].items():

def fit_held(folder):
    """Fit the visible box surfaces; the kinematics provide only an initial guess."""
    p=cloud(folder)
    meta=json.loads((Path(folder)/'meta.json').read_text())
    H=fk(meta['proprio']['now'][:7])
    R0=H[:3,:3]@Rdown.T
    center=H[:3,3]+H[:3,:3]@np.array([-.0006,-.002,.004])
    def residual(x):
        R=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[3:]).as_matrix()@R0
        d=np.abs((p-x[:3])@R)-[.02,.02,.03]
        sdf=np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(d,0),axis=1)+np.minimum(d.max(axis=1),0)
        return np.r_[sdf,.001*x[3:],.002*(x[:3]-center)]
    f=least_squares(residual,np.r_[center,[0,0,0]],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=.001,max_nfev=150)
    B=np.eye(4)
    B[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_rotvec(f.x[3:]).as_matrix()@R0
    B[:3,3]=f.x[:3]
    np.savez(Path(folder)/'fit.npz',p=B[:3,3],R=B[:3,:3])
    return B


def capture(res,label):
    global obs
    obs=res
    folder=OUT/label
    res.save(str(folder))
    for cam,im in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(folder/(cam+'.png'))
    np.savez(folder/'images.npz',**res.last)
    print(label,'time left:',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return res


def move_cart(p,R,opening=0,duration=4,label='move',settle=.5,compensate=True):
    """Slow Cartesian waypoints with IK and measured static servo-error correction."""
    now=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
    q=now[:7]; T0=fk(q)
    bias=now[16:23]-q if compensate else np.zeros(7)
    slerp=Slerp([0,1],Rotation.from_matrix([T0[:3,:3],R]))
    A=[]
    for t in np.linspace(0,1,int(duration/.04)+1)[1:]:
        s=t*t*(3-2*t)
        q=ik(T0[:3,3]*(1-s)+np.asarray(p)*s,slerp(s).as_matrix(),q)
        A.append(np.r_[q+bias,opening])
    A.extend([A[-1]]*int(settle/.04))
    A=np.array(A)
    np.save(OUT/(label+'_actions.npy'),A)
    return capture(r.submit('joint_position',A,dt=.04,cameras=cams,
                           video='mp4',include_depth=True,note=label),label)


def move_box_to_target(B,label,duration):
    H=fk(np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])[:7])
    hand_box=np.linalg.inv(H)@B
    task=obs.meta['task']
    target_p=np.array(task['target_pos'])
    w,x,y,z=task['target_quat_wxyz']
    target_R=Rotation.from_quat([x,y,z,w]).as_matrix()
    Rgoal=target_R@hand_box[:3,:3].T
    pgoal=target_p-Rgoal@hand_box[:3,3]
    move_cart(pgoal,Rgoal,duration=duration,label=label,settle=1)


def main():
    global r,spec,cams,obs
    r=Robot()  # The sole service connection. There is no reset or state inspection.
    spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras'])
